SELECT d.fiscal_period_label, MIN(d.calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS d1,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_period_label=d.fiscal_period_label) AS lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_period_label=d.fiscal_period_label) AS dist_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_period_label=d.fiscal_period_label) AS dist_receipt_lines
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_period_label = 'FY2026/27 P05' GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('delivered','collected') THEN w.dispatch_date END, f.sale_date) AS bd,
           (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL AND w.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')) AS undispatched,
           (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web,
           f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
rets AS (
    SELECT -SUM(r.refund_net) AS v
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P05'
)
SELECT 'ours_dispatched_only' AS what, SUM(v) + (SELECT v FROM rets) AS total
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.bd WHERE d.fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P05' AND NOT undispatched
UNION ALL
SELECT 'undispatched_web_lines_in_P5_by_saledate', SUM(v) FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.bd WHERE d.fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P05' AND undispatched
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_rpt', SUM(c.net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P05' AND c.store_id<>999
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_rpt_incl_999', SUM(c.net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P05'

WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
